findings.evidence: In _probe_database(), task.exception() is called directly once task is in done without checking task.cancelled(). If a probe callable or internal timeout cancels the probe task, calling task.exception() raises asyncio.CancelledError, escaping _probe_database and _handle_healthz unhandled instead of
findings.title: Unchecked task cancellation before task.exception()

findings.evidence: tests/unit/metrics/test_healthz_database.py covers reachable, failing, stalling, and slow cancellation probes, but lacks a test asserting that a server initialized with database_probe=None preserves the baseline response contract (returning status 200 without the 'database' key).
findings.title: Missing unit test for default database_probe=None response contract
